Alex — thanks for the note and the MOP. We're excited to run this. Quick answers up front:

- Ops: we can staff the kickoff and run the load test; I'll loop in Ben (ops) and Monica (CS lead) so they're aware.
- Dedicated pool: not required to run the POC, but for the 250 seq/sec steady-state test we'll recommend a small dedicated capacity reservation to avoid noisy-neighbor variance. We can fall back to hosted variants if you prefer.

Proposed plan (first pass):
1) Kickoff (90m) — Introductions, success criteria, prompt inventory review, routing rules.
2) Guardrails & structured output — confirm field lists, failure modes, and scoring.
3) Ops runbook & test window — traffic generator prep, metrics to collect.
4) Load test (30m) — warmup + sustained window + quick post-run analysis.

Suggested kickoff slot: Wed Oct 13, 13:00–14:30 PDT. If that works we'll schedule the load-test block for Thu Oct 14, 09:00–11:00 PDT (includes warmup).

Deliverables before kickoff:
- Your prompt inventory (sample prompts + expected structured outputs)
- Traffic profile CSV (RPS distribution by minute)
- Any special routing rules or policy exceptions

I'll attach a short agenda and draft runbook for your review. Can you confirm attendees from Orbit (who will own the traffic generator and who will observe results)?

Thanks,
Jasmine

Alex — good to align on the new test slot. A few technical notes so expectations are clear: 

- Routing: we'll implement a routing policy that splits traffic by intent header ("inference_type") and routes to either a low-latency path (small context chat) or a high-throughput path (batched invoice extraction). We'll provide a sample policy you can run in staging.
- Dedicated capacity recommendation: for a predictable 250 seq/sec sustained run, we recommend reserving a 4-GPU pool (A100 class equivalent) for the two-hour window. That gives us headroom for KV-cache sizing and batching. If Orbit prefers not to reserve, we can throttle and shape traffic but variance will increase.
- Structured output: please confirm canonical field names for the extraction schema (invoice_id, total_amount, vendor_id, line_items[].amount). We'll add a simple output conformance check that flags schema mismatches.

I'll attach a short checklist runbook and link to our load profile template.

Thanks,
Karthik
Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime
